tests.description: Bullets spawn during shooting animations and damage the player; the gunslinger dashes randomly when hit.
tests.name: Gunslinger_Bullets_And_Hit_Dash
source: const gotBullet = await harness.stepUntil(() => harness.getObjects('Bullet').length > 0, { maxFrames: 600 });
harness.assert(gotBullet, 'A bullet was spawned while a shooting animation plays');
return hp !== undefined && hpBefore !== undefined && hp < hpBefore;
harness.assert(damaged, 'Player health decreased after being hit by a bullet');
const dashed = await harness.stepUntil(() => Math.abs(harness.getObjects('Gunslinger_NPC')[0].x - gsX) > 60, { maxFrames: 120 });
harness.assert(anim === 'dash_bwd' || anim === 'dash_fwd', 'Dash animation is dash_bwd or dash_fwd, got ' + anim);
